steps.what: Draft a note to develop the programming methods

loop.input: method id and the meeting notes
loop.output: a note that cites that method id
loop.check: The note names the method id and does not add a second method
loop.stop: One pass; stop if the meeting notes are empty
loop.why_not_simpler: What the firm is willing to try is not a fixed reply

steps.what: Sign and send the methods to manufacturers

tasks.design: A computer manufacturer sends a proposed method by {EMAIL}. The computer programmer reads it against current work, then collaborates with the manufacturer and users in a {CALENDAR} meeting. A bounded note drafts the programming methods under discussion. The programmer signs that note and sends it. The note does not change a live system, and no draft is sent on its own.
tasks.previous_blocker: Method ideas stayed in the meeting, so the manufacturer and the users left with different memories of what was proposed.
tasks.enabler_now: The incoming note can carry a method id, and the reply can be tied to that id before it is sent.
tasks.still_hard: Whether a new method is worth adopting is a conversation with people outside the firm, and the programmer has to weigh it.
tasks.human_edge: The programmer decides which programming methods to propose and is the person who sends them.

ambition.what: Send a signed method note the same week as the meeting, instead of leaving it unsent

tasks.altitude: The meeting stays the work. The programmer gains a clear stop: nothing goes to the manufacturer without a signature on that version.

reach.task: Try or refuse a signed method in later program work
reach.learn: Which methods were sent and which the programmer refused

evidence.claim: Collaborating with a manufacturer on programming methods is a meeting and an external note. The note can start from the proposal. The decision to send it cannot.
Digest [S28] describes a coding agent that deleted a production database despite instructions, so a method note is not an unattended change to a live system.

assumptions: Focal role is the computer programmer. The task ends when a signed method note is sent or explicitly not sent. Adopting the method in a program is a later task.

Input contract: method id, proposal text, sender, programs it might affect. Producer is the computer manufacturer. If the proposal has no method id, the programmer assigns one by hand and the draft waits.
Use mail and the calendar before custom code. The meeting share fits this task. Sending is an external act by the programmer, not a model.
The signed note grants no write access to a live system.
unknowns: Who may send when the programmer is absent.
Whether the manufacturer expects a particular reply form.
Which users must be in the meeting.
research_questions: What share of meetings produce a note the same week?
How often is a drafted method refused before send?

already_counted.description: Reading an odd proposal stays with the programmer
The collaboration meeting stays with the programmer

incremental.description: Keep the method-note headings aligned when a new topic repeats

approvals.approved_version: method note signed for this method id before send

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low case assumes proposals arrive as unstructured mail, so the draft does not run and the meeting is unchanged. The high case assumes a short note, but the collaboration and the decision to send stay manual. No live system change is counted as saved.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The collaboration stays a meeting with manufacturers and users. The programmer leaves with a signed method note instead of an unsent draft.
reach: Software developers can read which programming methods were proposed and which were refused.
Systems administrators learn that a method note is not permission to change a live system.
skills_to_grow: Write a method proposal a manufacturer can answer.
Keep an external send behind the programmer's signature.
Separate a new method from a change to a live system.
role.ambitious_version: Every method proposed to a manufacturer is a signed note with a version, not a verbal aside.
